newHookFiles.responsibility: Run queued/running/success/failure/cancellation record lifecycle; persistence warnings; successful current Run association; Pareto selection lifecycle metadata.
Current/historical report definitions, deferred report modules, artifact retention/download/regeneration/deletion coordination and report warning.

responsibilitiesMoved: Run record capture and persistence coordination, persistence warning and currentResultRun association from App into useRunExecution.
Report/artifact generation, deferred rendering imports, historical source resolution, retention/download/regeneration actions and report warning from App into useReportWorkflow.
Project artifact cleanup now uses useReportArtifacts public action and keeps its transaction failure visible to App.
responsibilitiesRemaining: App remains the composition root for dataset/bootstrap ordering, Project/Scenario hydration and guards, RF request builders/API calls, simulation and optimization result interpretation, map/result overlays, central invalidation, apply/rerun transactions and cross-feature navigation.
useProjectWorkspace remains the existing persistence/domain boundary; no wrapper was added.
RF equations, optimizer policy, request schemas, repository schemas and report domain/rendering semantics remain in their existing layers.
interpretation: App responsibilities are clearer because two cohesive workflow lifecycles now have named owners and hook-level tests. LOC/import and byte counts are descriptive; no percentage improvement claim is made.
